# The Inn at Burklyn (concept by Kerblabs)

> 14-room family-run inn in a 1904 neoclassical mansion on Darling Hill Road, East Burke, Vermont. Facts from theinnatburklyn.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Address: 2864 Darling Hill Road, East Burke, VT 05832
- Phone: 802-626-1111
- Built: 1904, as Elmer Darling's private residence
- Rooms: 14, each with private en-suite bathroom

## Amenities
- Gourmet onsite breakfast
- Original fireplaces
- Wrap-around porch
- 86-acre grounds
- Darlings seasonal bar

## FAQ
- Where? East Burke, Vermont.
- Rates? Not published in the source pages; use the inn's own booking calendar.
